headline: Diagnostics strength carries the quarter; guidance raised
summary_short: Revvity's revenue rose 1.3% y/y to $729.7M (pro forma +4%) as 11% organic growth in Diagnostics offset a 3% organic decline in Life Sciences; GAAP EPS from continuing operations was $0.48 and adjusted EPS rose to $1.41 from $1.18, aided by $16 million of tariff-related refunds.
summary_long: Revenue grew 1.3% y/y to $729.7M (4% pro forma growth) as Diagnostics organic revenue rose 11% on demand strength, while Life Sciences organic revenue fell 3%. GAAP operating margin from continuing operations was 12.2%, down from 12.6% a year ago, though adjusted operating margin expanded to 28.9% from 26.6%, helped by $16 million of tariff-related refunds. Adjusted EPS from continuing operations rose to $1.41 from $1.18. The company entered a definitive agreement to divest its China Immunodiagnostics business and raised full-year 2026 pro forma guidance to $2.83-$2.86 billion revenue and $5.30-$5.40 adjusted EPS. Cash rose to $1,022.9 million from $860.3 million quarter-over-quarter.
